verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.ultrametric.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) indexing markdown pages. Every doc page is served as a .md URL, and the docs are written for agents: they direct agents to use `--json` and explain when to use the CLI versus MCP. The CLI also writes agent-facing SKILL.md instruction files for Codex and Claude Code, which a dry-run probe confirmed. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or a full view of the llms.txt contents beyond the first entry, and no independent (non-vendor) corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs.
